run_parse_demos_cli: run the CLI to parse tele-op demo logs from a directory of .mjl files for a given gym env
render_demos: render demo trajectories as a video by replaying qpos and qvel data without physics simulation
gather_training_data: playback demo trajectories with physics respected and collect observation-action pairs for training
save_parsed_logs: save parsed .mjl log data as a pickle file for later inspection or processing
viz_parsed_logs: plot and visualize parsed tele-op demo logs to inspect trajectory data
